Found 19 items in registries @ramonclaudio-coderabbit:

Showing items 1-19 of 19:

- core (registry:block) - Core CodeRabbit integration with types, API client, server actions, and React hook. Add a storage adapter separately for persistence. [@ramonclaudio-coderabbit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- types (registry:lib) - Pure TypeScript types for CodeRabbit API integration. Framework-agnostic type definitions with zero dependencies. [@ramonclaudio-coderabbit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- client (registry:lib) - Framework-agnostic CodeRabbit API client. Works in Node.js, Deno, Bun, Edge runtimes, and browsers. Single endpoint for generating developer activity reports with 10-minute timeout support. [@ramonclaudio-coderabbit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- storage-adapter (registry:lib) - TypeScript interface for implementing custom storage backends. Implement this to add support for any database. [@ramonclaudio-coderabbit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- storage-localstorage (registry:lib) - Browser localStorage adapter for CodeRabbit reports. Perfect for client-side apps and prototyping. No database required. [@ramonclaudio-coderabbit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- storage-convex (registry:lib) - Convex database adapter with real-time sync and auth support. Includes schema definitions for the reports table. [@ramonclaudio-coderabbit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- storage-supabase (registry:lib) - Supabase (PostgreSQL) adapter with Row Level Security support. Includes SQL schema and RLS policies. [@ramonclaudio-coderabbit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- storage-postgres (registry:lib) - PostgreSQL adapter with connection pooling. Works with Neon, Vercel Postgres, Railway, AWS RDS, Google Cloud SQL, etc. [@ramonclaudio-coderabbit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- storage-mysql (registry:lib) - MySQL/MariaDB adapter with connection pooling. Works with PlanetScale, AWS RDS, Google Cloud SQL, Azure, etc. [@ramonclaudio-coderabbit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- actions (registry:lib) - Next.js server actions for CodeRabbit API. Handles API calls server-side where CODERABBIT_API_KEY is securely available. [@ramonclaudio-coderabbit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- react (registry:hook) - React hook for generating CodeRabbit reports with built-in loading and error states. Uses server actions by default for secure API key handling in Next.js. [@ramonclaudio-coderabbit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- report-form (registry:component) - Full-featured form component for collecting report parameters. Includes template selection, custom prompts, filters, and grouping options. [@ramonclaudio-coderabbit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- branding (registry:component) - CodeRabbit logo and icon components with dark/light theme support. Includes SVG assets. [@ramonclaudio-coderabbit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- report-card (registry:component) - Display component for CodeRabbit reports with expandable cards, status badges, and markdown rendering. Supports Daily Standup, Sprint Report, and Release Notes formats. [@ramonclaudio-coderabbit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- localstorage (registry:block) - Complete CodeRabbit integration with browser localStorage. Perfect for prototyping and client-side apps. No database required. [@ramonclaudio-coderabbit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- convex (registry:block) - Complete CodeRabbit integration with Convex database. Includes real-time sync, auth support, and schema definitions. Perfect for production apps. [@ramonclaudio-coderabbit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- supabase (registry:block) - Complete CodeRabbit integration with Supabase (PostgreSQL). Includes Row Level Security policies. Perfect for apps with authentication. [@ramonclaudio-coderabbit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- postgres (registry:block) - Complete CodeRabbit integration with PostgreSQL. Works with Neon, Vercel Postgres, Railway, AWS RDS, etc. [@ramonclaudio-coderabbit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- mysql (registry:block) - Complete CodeRabbit integration with MySQL/MariaDB. Works with PlanetScale, AWS RDS, Google Cloud SQL, Azure, etc. [@ramonclaudio-coderabbit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
